scope: Two-layer random-weight Qwen3; QEMU/TCG wall time, not full-model or hardware performance

configuration.numeric_rule: All finite valid elements: max_abs < atol; greedy tokens equal

timing_scope.call_wall_s: Outer Prefill/Decode call wall time including Host input preparation; excludes subsequent K/V dump and comparison
timing_scope.total_s: Runtime request wall time: command send, forward, logits QMP transfer and validation; excludes Host input preparation
timing_scope.forward_s: Runtime command send to UART response, including guest validation and forward
timing_scope.output_transfer_s: Part of total_s: QMP stop, complete logits read/validation and resume
timing_scope.excluded: All call/request/forward timing columns exclude export/build, session startup, RESET, debug K/V dump, ORT and comparisons. Host input preparation is included in call_wall_s, but excluded from total_s and forward_s
timing_scope.pairing: Two resident sessions; one executes at a time; one warmup each; alternating AB/BA
timing_scope.units: Elapsed wall seconds; concurrent threads' CPU times are not added

versions.target: riscv64 / RV64GC / LP64D / QEMU virt / bare metal
riscv64 / RV64GC / LP64D / QEMU virt / bare metal

publication.raw_data_location: Local output directory; raw ONNX, ELF, logs and tensor dumps are not stored in Git

measurement_code.description: Merged W6 code plus uncommitted KV integration and short Prefill support, including the fixed FP32 cache-tail buffer for exporter compatibility

publication.scope: Copy of the final completed small-model measurement; publishing this summary does not constitute a new run
